posts.text: Welcome to Hexo! This is your very first post. Check documentation for more info. 日语假名随机练习（带手写板） body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh; background-color: #f0f2f5; margin: 0; /* 防止手机端下拉刷新干扰手写 */ overscroll-behavior: none; } .card { background: white; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); text-align: center; width: 90%; max-width: 400px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } h1 { font-size: 1.2rem; color: #666; margin: 0 0 15px 0; } .display-area { width: 100%; margin-bottom: 10px; } .question { font-size: 4rem; font-weight: bold; color: #333; margin: 5px 0; line-height: 1; } .question-type { font-size: 0.9rem; color: #888; background: #eee; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block; } /* 手写板样式 */ .canvas-container { position: relative; margin: 10px 0; border: 2px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; background-color: #fff9f0; /*以此区分书写区域 */ cursor: crosshair; touch-action: none; /* 关键：禁止触摸时的滚动行为 */ } canvas { display: block; } .clear-icon { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 2px 6px; cursor: pointer; color: #666; } .clear-icon:hover { background: #eee; } .answer { margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 2px dashed #eee; width: 100%; display: none; } .answer.show { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-in; } .answer-item { font-size: 1.2rem; color: #007bff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .answer-label { font-size: 0.7rem; color: #999; margin-bottom: 2px; } .btn-group { margin-top: 20px; display: flex; gap: 10px; width: 100%; } button { flex: 1; padding: 12px; font-size: 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; font-weight: bold; } #rand-btn { background-color: #28a745; color: white; } #rand-btn:hover { background-color: #218838; } #submit-btn { background-color: #007bff; color: white; } #submit-btn:hover { background-color: #0069d9; } #submit-btn:disabled { background-color: #ccc; cursor: not-allowed; } @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-5px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } 假名练习 & 手写板 点击 Rand 开始 ? 清除 Rand (下一题) Submit (看答案) // --- 1. 数据部分 --- const kanaData = [ // 清音 { h: 'あ', k: 'ア', r: 'a' }, { h: 'い', k: 'イ', r: 'i' }, { h: 'う', k: 'ウ', r: 'u' }, { h: 'え', k: 'エ', r: 'e' }, { h: 'お', k: 'オ', r: 'o' }, { h: 'か', k: 'カ', r: 'ka' }, { h: 'き', k: 'キ', r: 'ki' }, { h: 'く', k: 'ク', r: 'ku' }, { h: 'け', k: 'ケ', r: 'ke' }, { h: 'こ', k: 'コ', r: 'ko' }, { h: 'さ', k: 'サ', r: 'sa' }, { h: 'し', k: 'シ', r: 'shi' }, { h: 'す', k: 'ス', r: 'su' }, { h: 'せ', k: 'セ', r: 'se' }, { h: 'そ', k: 'ソ', r: 'so' }, { h: 'た', k: 'タ', r: 'ta' }, { h: 'ち', k: 'チ', r: 'chi' }, { h: 'つ', k: 'ツ', r: 'tsu' }, { h: 'て', k: 'テ', r: 'te' }, { h: 'と', k: 'ト', r: 'to' }, { h: 'な', k: 'ナ', r: 'na' }, { h: 'に', k: 'ニ', r: 'ni' }, { h: 'ぬ', k: 'ヌ', r: 'nu' }, { h: 'ね', k: 'ネ', r: 'ne' }, { h: 'の', k: 'ノ', r: 'no' }, { h: 'は', k: 'ハ', r: 'ha' }, { h: 'ひ', k: 'ヒ', r: 'hi' }, { h: 'ふ', k: 'フ', r: 'fu' }, { h: 'へ', k: 'ヘ', r: 'he' }, { h: 'ほ', k: 'ホ', r: 'ho' }, { h: 'ま', k: 'マ', r: 'ma' }, { h: 'み', k: 'ミ', r: 'mi' }, { h: 'む', k: 'ム', r: 'mu' }, { h: 'め', k: 'メ', r: 'me' }, { h: 'も', k: 'モ', r: 'mo' }, { h: 'や', k: 'ヤ', r: 'ya' }, { h: 'ゆ', k: 'ユ', r: 'yu' }, { h: 'よ', k: 'ヨ', r: 'yo' }, { h: 'ら', k: 'ラ', r: 'ra' }, { h: 'り', k: 'リ', r: 'ri' }, { h: 'る', k: 'ル', r: 'ru' }, { h: 'れ', k: 'レ', r: 're' }, { h: 'ろ', k: 'ロ', r: 'ro' }, { h: 'わ', k: 'ワ', r: 'wa' }, { h: 'を', k: 'ヲ', r: 'wo' }, { h: 'ん', k: 'ン', r: 'n' }, // 浊音 { h: 'が', k: 'ガ', r: 'ga' }, { h: 'ぎ', k: 'ギ', r: 'gi' }, { h: 'ぐ', k: 'グ', r: 'gu' }, { h: 'げ', k: 'ゲ', r: 'ge' }, { h: 'ご', k: 'ゴ', r: 'go' }, { h: 'ざ', k: 'ザ', r: 'za' }, { h: 'じ', k: 'ジ', r: 'ji' }, { h: 'ず', k: 'ズ', r: 'zu' }, { h: 'ぜ', k: 'ゼ', r: 'ze' }, { h: 'ぞ', k: 'ゾ', r: 'zo' }, { h: 'だ', k: 'ダ', r: 'da' }, { h: 'ぢ', k: 'ヂ', r: 'ji' }, { h: 'づ', k: 'ヅ', r: 'zu' }, { h: 'で', k: 'デ', r: 'de' }, { h: 'ど', k: 'ド', r: 'do' }, { h: 'ば', k: 'バ', r: 'ba' }, { h: 'び', k: 'ビ', r: 'bi' }, { h: 'ぶ', k: 'ブ', r: 'bu' }, { h: 'べ', k: 'ベ', r: 'be' }, { h: 'ぼ', k: 'ボ', r: 'bo' }, // 半浊音 { h: 'ぱ', k: 'パ', r: 'pa' }, { h: 'ぴ', k: 'ピ', r: 'pi' }, { h: 'ぷ', k: 'プ', r: 'pu' }, { h: 'ぺ', k: 'ペ', r: 'pe' }, { h: 'ぽ', k: 'ポ', r: 'po' } ]; // --- 2. 逻辑控制 --- const questionText = document.getElementById('question-text'); const questionLabel = document.getElementById('question-label'); const answerBox = document.getElementById('answer-box'); const randBtn = document.getElementById('rand-btn'); const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submit-btn'); let currentItem = null; let currentType = null; function getRandomInt(max) { return Math.floor(Math.random() * max); } function renderQuestion() { const index = getRandomInt(kanaData.length); currentItem = kanaData[index]; const mode = getRandomInt(3); // 重置界面 answerBox.classList.remove('show'); answerBox.innerHTML = ''; submitBtn.disabled = false; // **关键修改：切换题目时自动清空手写板** clearCanvas(); if (mode === 0) { currentType = 'h'; questionText.textContent = currentItem.h; questionLabel.textContent = "平假名 (Hiragana)"; } else if (mode === 1) { currentType = 'k'; questionText.textContent = currentItem.k; questionLabel.textContent = "片假名 (Katakana)"; } else { currentType = 'r'; questionText.textContent = currentItem.r; questionLabel.textContent = "罗马音 (Romaji)"; } } function renderAnswer() { if (!currentItem) return; let html = ''; if (currentType !== 'h') html += `平假名${currentItem.h}`; if (currentType !== 'k') html += `片假名${currentItem.k}`; if (currentType !== 'r') html += `罗马音${currentItem.r}`; answerBox.innerHTML = html; answerBox.classList.add('show'); submitBtn.disabled = true; } randBtn.addEventListener('click', renderQuestion); submitBtn.addEventListener('click', renderAnswer); // --- 3. 手写板功能实现 (Canvas) --- const canvas = document.getElementById('writing-pad'); const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); const clearCanvasBtn = document.getElementById('clear-canvas-btn'); let isDrawing = false; // 配置画笔 ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#333'; // 获取坐标辅助函数 function getPos(e) { const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); // 触摸事件 if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) { return { x: e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left, y: e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top }; } // 鼠标事件 return { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top }; } function startDrawing(e) { isDrawing = true; const pos = getPos(e); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pos.x, pos.y); } function draw(e) { if (!isDrawing) return; e.preventDefault(); // 防止手机端拖动页面 const pos = getPos(e); ctx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y); ctx.stroke(); } function stopDrawing() { isDrawing = false; ctx.closePath(); } function clearCanvas() { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); } // 鼠标事件 (电脑端) canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', startDrawing); canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', draw); canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', stopDrawing); canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', stopDrawing); // 触摸事件 (手机端) canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', startDrawing, {passive: false}); canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', draw, {passive: false}); canvas.addEventListener('touchend', stopDrawing); // 清除按钮事件 clearCanvasBtn.addEventListener('click', clearCanvas); // 初始化 renderQuestion();
